function.name: play
function.description: Play 1-5 cards from your hand as a poker hand. HAND stops only.

cards.description: Card tokens from your hand, e.g. ["Kh", "Qh", "Ts"]. Use #N for duplicates: "Kh#2". Cards score left to right IN THIS ORDER — list xMult cards (Glass, Polychrome) last.

reasoning.description: Strategic reasoning: expected score vs pace requirement, why these cards.

function.name: discard
function.description: Discard 1-5 cards and draw replacements. HAND stops only.

reasoning.description: What you are digging for and why discarding beats a cycling play.

function.name: use_consumable
function.description: Fire a held consumable (Tarot / Planet / Spectral) from your consumable slots. Targeting cards can only aim at hand cards, so fire those at a HAND stop.

cards.description: Hand-card tokens to target, for consumables that select cards. Omit for untargeted ones.

reasoning.description: Why now, and why these targets.

function.name: sell
function.description: Sell a joker or held consumable for its sell value. Legal at any stop, including mid-blind.

item.description: Joker or consumable key, e.g. "j_egg" or "c_pluto".

reasoning.description: Why selling beats keeping (remember: sell value is half cost).

function.name: copy_card
function.description: Death tarot only: convert target card into an exact copy of source card. Both must be in your hand; requires holding c_death. HAND stops only.

source.description: Card token to copy FROM (this card survives unchanged).

target.description: Card token that becomes a copy of source (its old identity is lost).

function.name: order_jokers
function.description: Reorder your joker board (free, unlimited). Valid ONLY during a blind (HAND stop) or in the shop -- not at blind select or inside an open pack. List the keys in the desired left-to-right trigger order; listed jokers move to the front in that order, unlisted ones keep their relative order after them.

order.description: Joker keys left-to-right, e.g. ["j_sly", "j_jolly", "j_duo"]. +Chips/+Mult left, xMult right; Blueprint copies its RIGHT neighbor, Brainstorm copies the LEFTMOST joker.

reasoning.description: Which trigger interaction this order wins.

function.name: choose
function.description: Take one of the numbered options listed at an ECON stop (buy, open pack, reroll, select or skip blind, leave shop, untargeted pack pick, ...).

option.description: The option's index from the numbered list in the state message.

reasoning.description: Why this option beats the alternatives, including doing nothing.

function.name: pick_pack_card
function.description: Pick a card from an open booster pack and aim it at explicit targets among your dealt cards. Use this instead of choose whenever the pick is a targeting Tarot/Spectral, so it never fires on auto-targets.

card.description: Pack card key, e.g. "c_strength". #N picks duplicates.

targets.description: Dealt-card tokens to aim at (shown in the state block during pack opening).

reasoning.description: Why this pick and these targets.
